title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.375]. On the first face, draw two concentric circles. The first circle has its center at [0.0268, 0.0268] with a radius of 0.0268, and the second circle has the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0246. Apply a scale factor of 0.0536 to the entire 2D sketch. Rotate the 2D sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.375]. Extrude the 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.1875 units, and then extrude it in the opposite direction by the same distance. This process forms a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.05357142857142857 units in length and width, and 0.375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0.0268, 0.0268, 0.375))

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .circle(0.0268)  # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0246)  # Inner circle (for the hole)
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Hollow tube: outer diameter 0.0536, height 0.375
outer_d = 0.0536
inner_d = 0.0470
height = 0.375

# Outer cylinder
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_d / 2).extrude(height)

# Inner bore
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_d / 2).extrude(height)

# Tube = outer minus inner
tube = outer.cut(inner)

# The visible seam at mid-height suggests the tube is composed of
# two equal stacked segments; build them as two solids combined.
half = height / 2
seg1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_d / 2).extrude(half) \
        .cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_d / 2).extrude(half))
seg2 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=half).circle(outer_d / 2).extrude(half) \
        .cut(cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=half).circle(inner_d / 2).extrude(half))

r = seg1.union(seg2)
